intro: This policy explains what we collect when you use Best Rummy Hubs and how we handle it. We are an independent information site, not a gaming operator.

sections.heading: Information we collect

sections.heading: How we use information
sections.body: Data helps us improve guides, measure traffic, and prevent abuse. We do not sell personal information. Contact us at the email in our site footer for privacy questions.

sections.heading: Third-party links
sections.body: Download buttons open official operator invite or store URLs. Those sites have their own privacy policies, review them before creating an account.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can disable cookies in your browser. You may request correction or deletion of data you sent us directly (e.g. by email), subject to legal retention requirements.

faqs.question: Do you store payment details?
faqs.answer: No. Payments happen only on third-party apps you choose to install. We never collect card or UPI data on this site.

faqs.answer: Best Rummy Hubs operates this informational website. Contact playearnhubs@gmail.com for privacy requests.
